newsitem.title: UK: Scottish & Newcastle leads up UK brewers.
newsitem.headline: Scottish & Newcastle leads up UK brewers.

text.p: Shares in British brewers were lifted on Friday against a weaker market, helped by expectations of robust annual results from Scottish and Newcastle Plc on Monday, dealers said.
By 0920 GMT Scottish & Newcastle gained six pence to 635p while Bass was up 2-1/2p to 737-1/2p.
The FTSE 100 was down 33.2 points at 4,624.7 points.
"The brewers are up in general on the back of hopes that Scottish & Newcastle will deliver strong figures", one trader said.
Analysts expect the company to report profits of 361 to 380 million stg, up from 308 million pounds the previous year.
Elsewhere in the sector, drinks group Allied Domecq firmed 2-1/2p to 425-1/2. Whitbread was unchanged at 478p.
